command:
/bin/zsh -lc 'task_script=$(mktemp /tmp/count-access-XXXXXX.py)
cat > "$task_script" <<'"'PY'
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path

start = datetime(2026, 10, 9, 10, tzinfo=timezone.utc)
end = datetime(2026, 10, 9, 11, tzinfo=timezone.utc)

def matches(line):
    fields = line.split()
    timestamp = datetime.fromisoformat(fields[0].replace('Z', '+00:00'))
    status = int(fields[3])
    return start <= timestamp < end and 500 <= status <= 599

with Path('access.log').open() as log:
    sample = [next(log) for _ in range(8)]
assert sum(matches(line) for line in sample) == 2
assert matches('2026-10-09T10:00:00Z GET / 500 503')
assert matches('2026-10-09T10:59:59Z GET / 599 503')
assert not matches('2026-10-09T11:00:00Z GET / 500 503')
assert not matches('2026-10-09T10:30:00Z GET /500 200 503')

with Path('access.log').open() as log:
    count = sum(matches(line) for line in log if line.strip())
Path('answer.txt').write_text(f'{count}\\n')
assert Path('answer.txt').read_text() == f'{count}\\n'
print(count)
PY
python3 \""'$task_script"'
